mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_image ( class_id, image_url, sort_order, is_thumbnail ) VALUES ( #{classId}, #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{thumbnail} )
mapper.select: SELECT image_id AS imageId, class_id AS classId, image_url AS imageUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_thumbnail AS thumbnail, created_at AS createdAt FROM class_image WHERE class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY is_thumbnail DESC, sort_order ASC
SELECT image_id AS imageId, class_id AS classId, image_url AS imageUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_thumbnail AS thumbnail, created_at AS createdAt FROM class_image WHERE image_id = #{imageId}

SELECT image_id AS imageId, class_id AS classId, image_url AS imageUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_thumbnail AS thumbnail, created_at AS createdAt FROM class_image WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND is_thumbnail = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC LIMIT 1
